title: SIU investigates fatal shooting in Northern Ontario
article: The Special Investigations Unit is looking into the circumstances surrounding the police shooting of a man in northwest Ontario.
The SIU says provincial police officers were called early Sunday to help Lac Seul police officers at a residence in Whitefish Bay.
While there, says the SIU, there was an "interaction" with a 39-year-old man and he was shot and later died in hospital.
Provincial police, meanwhile, are investigating a separate but related death at the same residence in the community southeast of Kenora.
The circumstances behind the death of the second person have not been released, nor have that person's name or age.
The SIU is called in whenever there is death, serious injury or sexual assault involving police and the public.
